stories.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis — and a human did, too
stories.explanation: An Anthropic mathematician, Levent Alpöge, claims to have found a Lean-compilable solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis, a major mathematical problem. This development coincides with Anthropic becoming a publicly traded company.

stories.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
stories.explanation: A researcher planted 2 million digital tripwires in AI service requests, revealing that sensitive data can leak through the AI supply chain, particularly via 'AI routers' or 'AI gateways'. This experiment exposed a privacy disaster in the AI ecosystem.

stories.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
stories.explanation: Meta is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero emissions goal due to record greenhouse gas emissions from its rapidly expanding AI data centers. The company acknowledges that demand for AI infrastructure has grown faster than projected, impacting its sustainability timelines.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
stories.explanation: Donald Trump has threatened to impose a 'tremendous tax' on companies that build AI data centers outside of the US. This policy aims to keep AI infrastructure development within the country, despite domestic restrictions on data center construction.

stories.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
stories.explanation: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR indicates that some AI capabilities continue to improve exponentially, particularly in coding tasks. However, the report also highlights that models show weaknesses in tasks requiring human judgment.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
stories.explanation: An Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved the Riemann hypothesis, a Millennium Prize problem, with the help of Claude. If verified, this would be a significant achievement for AI in mathematics.

stories.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
stories.explanation: Apple appears to be developing its own AI agent capable of performing computer tasks like browsing the web, working across apps, and coding. This development would position Apple to compete with other AI agent providers.

stories.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
stories.explanation: OpenAI is sharing its layered approach to combat adversarial distillation, which involves unauthorized reproduction of frontier model capabilities. This aims to strengthen safeguards across the industry against misuse of AI models.

stories.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
stories.explanation: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to prevent AI agents like Gemini and Siri from accessing user messages and data. This move aims to protect user privacy against AI capabilities that analyze on-screen information.

stories.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
stories.explanation: Hebbia tested OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and found improvements in financial research, specifically in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality. This indicates a practical application of the AI model in a professional domain.
